four_bit_packing.address: regular transfer row_base + floor(column / 2), where row_base = base + row * row_stride_bytes
four_bit_packing.odd_tail: preserve-unused-sibling-bits at every byte-aligned row tail

architecture_contract.regular_gm_addressing: TLOAD and TSTORE use B.IOR.RegSrc1 as the byte distance between adjacent row starts; the dense omission default is ceil(physical_columns * element_bits / 8) bytes and encoded zero remains zero.
architecture_contract.indexed_operations: Gather, scatter, masked variants, and CAS sign- or zero-extend each integer IndexTile element as a byte displacement and add it directly to the base without transfer-type scaling.
architecture_contract.indexed_packed_transfer: Packed four-bit transfer data rejects before effects because indexed TLSU has no low/high-nibble selector; packed integer IndexTile elements remain legal byte displacements.
architecture_contract.masked_operations: MGATHER_MASK and MSCATTER_MASK apply the per-lane mask before any memory effect; masked-off gather lanes receive the bundle pad value.
architecture_contract.cas_operation: MGATHER_CAS returns the old lane value and stores the replacement only when the old value equals the expected lane, recording one atomic event per lane.
architecture_contract.events: Each four-bit logical lane emits one byte-sized memory event over the containing byte.
architecture_contract.preflight: The complete containing-byte footprint is probed before payload, memory, event, or reservation effects.
architecture_contract.gmov: Core4 peer source is resolved before the one-level direct-operation carrier; GMOV copies that read-old fragment to the compatible local destination.
